adult_smoking_rate.source: 國民健康署 國人吸菸行為調查結果 圖1 歷年18歲以上成人吸菸率－標準化 (1990-1996 菸酒公賣局家戶調查; 1999 李蘭 電訪調查; 2002 國民健康促進知識態度行為調查; 2004+ 國人吸菸行為調查, biennial from 2019)
adult_smoking_rate.unit: % of adults 18+ who currently smoke cigarettes
adult_smoking_rate.notes: Survey years only (values read from labelled data points of the official chart). Definitions: 1990-1996 smoker = smokes >=3 cigarettes/day (公賣局 face-to-face survey); 1999+ = >=100 cigarettes lifetime and smoked in past 30 days. 2004+ standardized to 2000 census population. No official adult smoking survey found before 1990 (pre-1990 公賣局 surveys not located online). E-cigarette use 18+: 0.6% (2018), 1.7% (2020), 1.0% (2024).

drinking_rate.source: 國民健康署/國衛院 國民健康訪問調查 (NHIS); 健康促進統計年報 103年 表2-2-2 and 114年 表2-2-5 18歲以上人口過去一年飲酒率
drinking_rate.unit: % of adults 18+ who drank alcohol in the past year
drinking_rate.notes: NHIS every 4 years; 2009 from 103年年報 (url https://www.hpa.gov.tw/Pages/Detail.aspx?nodeid=268&pid=7529). 2021 by age (both sexes): 18-29 53.7, 30-39 46.7, 40-49 43.1, 50-64 34.7, 65+ 18.0; indigenous 59.4. NHIS 2001/2005 adult drinking rates with comparable definition not located. No official pre-2001 series.

betel_nut_chewing_rate.source: 國民健康署 成人吸菸/健康危害行為監測調查 → 健康促進暨國人健康行為監測調查; 健康促進統計年報 103年 表2-3-1, 114年 表2-3-3 18歲以上人口嚼檳榔率
betel_nut_chewing_rate.unit: % of adults 18+ currently chewing betel quid
betel_nut_chewing_rate.notes: 2007-2011 male only (from 103年年報, url https://www.hpa.gov.tw/Pages/Detail.aspx?nodeid=268&pid=7529). 2023 value is the pooled 2023-2024 (民國112-113年) estimate; pooled 2022-2023 = M4.6 F0.2 T2.4. Not surveyed/published 2019-2021. 2023-24 by age (male): 18-29 1.6, 30-39 6.4, 40-49 6.4, 50-64 4.7, 65+ 2.1; highest county Taitung M12.7. 2014 by age (male): 30-39 14.0, 40-49 15.1. No official national adult series before 2007 located (NHIS 2001/2005 not retrieved). Junior-high chewing 2013 1.2% (M1.6) to 2023 0.42%.

hbv_carrier_rate.source: 衛福部疾管署 疫情報導 32(14) 2016「臺灣B型肝炎防治」(劉嘉玲等); 疾管局 98年度科技研究計畫 DOH98-DC-1103 期末報告

1993.note: ~10 yrs after program (Hsu 1999, cited by CDC report); pre-program comparison 10.5%

2009.note: grades 1/4/7/10 sample, cohorts born 8-17 yrs after universal vaccination

hbv_carrier_rate.notes: Cohort rule for simulation: vaccination began July 1984 for newborns of carrier mothers; universal newborn vaccination from July 1986 (3rd-dose coverage 87% in 1984 rising to >95% from 2001). Born before ~1984: carrier rate ~15-20% (older adults; no sex split published here, though males have higher carrier rates in literature). Born 1986+: ~1% or less. Pregnant-women HBsAg+ fell from 13.4-18.0% (mid-1980s) to 7.3% (2014) as vaccinated cohorts reached childbearing age. Values are survey/report points, not annual series.

hypertension_diabetes_prevalence.source: 國民健康署 國民營養健康狀況變遷調查 (NAHSIT) / 國民營養健康調查; 健康促進統計年報 103年 表1-2-1 (20歲以上) and 114年 表1-2-3 (18歲以上, 4-5年滾動)
hypertension_diabetes_prevalence.notes: Key = approx. midpoint of pooled survey period (see period). Two series with different age bases (20+ in 103年年報; 18+ rolling in 114年年報) - not strictly comparable. Other rolling periods (18+): 2014-2017 HT 24.7/DM 9.66; 2016-2019 HT 25.8/DM 10.1; 2018-2022 HT 27.4/DM 11.3; 2019-2023 HT 28.9/DM 12.6. 2020-24 by age: HT 18-39 7.8, 40-64 30.7, 65+ 65.1; DM 18-39 2.68, 40-64 12.2, 65+ 31.3. 2005-08 by age: HT 20-39 3.0, 40-64 20.2, 65+ 60.0. Earlier official points (NAHSIT 1993-96; 2002 TwSHHH 三高調查) not retrieved as figures. Diabetes as cause of death (see mortality causes) rose from #12 (1981, males) into top 5 by 2000s.
